<h1 id="1-文档说明">1. 文档说明</h1>
<p>本文档针对在实际项目落地过程中，调用虹软（ArcSoft）人脸识别SDK出现的常见问题进行总结，涉及内容包括：</p>
<ul>
<li>性能优化（人脸识别速度提升、JPEG转BGR24性能优化等）</li>
<li>人脸抠图</li>
<li>多人脸图片中最优人脸选择</li>
<li>服务端高并发图片请求优化</li>
<li>内存泄漏排查</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="2-jpeg转bgr24耗时长优化">2. JPEG转BGR24耗时长优化</h2>
<p>在实际项目开发过程中，会遇到JPEG转BGR24耗时长问题，导致人脸操作整体耗时增加。java中自带原生图像处理类ImageIO，但是该接口转码速度较慢，内部实际流程如下：</p>
<pre><code>JPEG
&nbsp;↓
JPEG Decoder
&nbsp;↓
BufferedImage
&nbsp;↓
Raster
&nbsp;↓
byte[]
</code></pre>
<p>需要经历：</p>
<ul>
<li>JPEG解码</li>
<li>BufferedImage构造</li>
<li>ColorModel转换</li>
<li>Raster数据拷贝</li>
</ul>
<p>推荐使用javaCV接口实现图片转码，将jpeg转换成BRG24。</p>
<pre><code>Mat mat = imdecode(...)
</code></pre>
<p>内部流程：</p>
<pre><code>JPEG
&nbsp;↓
OpenCV
&nbsp;↓
libjpeg-turbo
&nbsp;↓
Mat(BGR)
</code></pre>
<p>直接输出：</p>
<pre><code>BGR24
</code></pre>
<p>减少了中间对象和颜色格式转换。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">import org.bytedeco.javacpp.BytePointer;
import org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat;

import static org.bytedeco.opencv.global.opencv_imgcodecs.imdecode;
import static org.bytedeco.opencv.global.opencv_imgcodecs.IMREAD_COLOR;
public class JpegDecoder {

&nbsp; &nbsp; public static BGRImage jpegToBGR(byte[] jpegData) {

&nbsp; &nbsp; BytePointer jpegPtr = new BytePointer(jpegData);

&nbsp; &nbsp; Mat jpegMat = new Mat(
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 1,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; jpegData.length,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; org.bytedeco.opencv.global.opencv_core.CV_8UC1,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; jpegPtr
&nbsp; &nbsp; );

&nbsp; &nbsp; Mat mat = imdecode(jpegMat, IMREAD_COLOR);

&nbsp; &nbsp; if (mat.empty()) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; throw new RuntimeException("decode failed");
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; int width = mat.cols();
&nbsp; &nbsp; int height = mat.rows();

&nbsp; &nbsp; byte[] bgr = new byte[width * height * 3];

&nbsp; &nbsp; mat.data().get(bgr);

&nbsp; &nbsp; mat.release();
&nbsp; &nbsp; jpegMat.release();
&nbsp; &nbsp; jpegPtr.close();

&nbsp; &nbsp; return new BGRImage(width, height, bgr);
}
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="3-服务器场景下高并发人脸图片请求耗时优化">3. 服务器场景下高并发人脸图片请求耗时优化</h1>
<p><strong>问题描述</strong></p>
<p>在Linux Server场景中，经常会遇到大量人脸图片并发请求的情况，这可能会导致人脸相关操作被阻塞，例如：人脸特征提取，人脸特征提取在SDK提供的接口中，耗时相对较高，高并发的人脸识别请求，会导致人脸特征提取耗时更长。</p>
<p><strong>推荐解决方案</strong></p>
<p>使用引擎池和线程池，能够有效解决上述问题，这里推荐人脸SDK引擎的数量和线程池中线程数量相同，线程数量不超过设备的核心数。具体可以参考链接：<a href="https://blog.csdn.net/qq_40110356/article/details/158689548" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">虹软人脸服务器版SDK(Linux/ARM Pro)多线程调用及性能优化_虹软 服务器版本-CSDN博客</a></p>
<hr>
<h1 id="4-如何实现高效精准的人脸抠图">4. 如何实现高效精准的人脸抠图</h1>
<p><strong>问题描述</strong></p>
<p>在服务器端人脸识别场景中，客户通常会上传一张图片，服务器调用人脸识别SDK完成人脸检测、人脸特征提取和身份识别。同时，很多项目还需要保存当前识别人员的人脸缩略图，用于：</p>
<ul>
<li>人员档案管理</li>
<li>访客记录存档</li>
<li>前端列表展示</li>
<li>历史记录查询</li>
<li>抓拍图片展示</li>
</ul>
<p>由于SDK输出的人脸框主要服务于人脸识别和特征提取，其框选区域通常较为紧凑，直接按照检测框裁剪，可能出现额头、下巴或脸部边缘缺失的问题，影响展示效果。</p>
<p><strong>推荐解决方案</strong></p>
<p>建议基于SDK返回的人脸框进行适当扩展后再进行裁剪。下面给出C++版本的裁剪代码示例，可以通过调用calcFaceROI得到可靠的裁剪ROI，函数中的缩放因子可以根据实际调整。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">struct FaceInput
{
&nbsp; &nbsp; int x1, y1, x2, y2;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float yaw;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float pitch;
&nbsp; &nbsp; int img_w;
&nbsp; &nbsp; int img_h;
};

struct FaceROI
{
&nbsp; &nbsp; int x1, y1, x2, y2;
};

#include &lt;algorithm&gt;
#include &lt;cmath&gt;

static float clampf(float x, float a, float b)
{
&nbsp; &nbsp; return std::min(std::max(x, a), b);
}

FaceROI calcFaceROI(const FaceInput&amp; in)
{
&nbsp; &nbsp; FaceROI out;

&nbsp; &nbsp; float x1 = (float)in.x1;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float y1 = (float)in.y1;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float x2 = (float)in.x2;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float y2 = (float)in.y2;

&nbsp; &nbsp; float w = x2 - x1;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float h = y2 - y1;

&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 根据人脸大小调整扩张比例
&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; float scale = 200.f / h;
&nbsp; &nbsp; scale = clampf(scale, 0.8f, 1.3f);

&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 左右固定扩张
&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; float left_expand &nbsp;= 0.35f * scale;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float right_expand = 0.35f * scale;

&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 上下根据pitch轻微调整
&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; float pitch_n = clampf(in.pitch / 45.f, -1.f, 1.f);

&nbsp; &nbsp; float top_expand &nbsp; &nbsp;= 0.55f * (1.f - pitch_n * 0.3f);
&nbsp; &nbsp; float bottom_expand = 0.45f * (1.f + pitch_n * 0.3f);

&nbsp; &nbsp; top_expand *= scale;
&nbsp; &nbsp; bottom_expand *= scale;

&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 计算ROI
&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; float nx1 = x1 - left_expand * w;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float nx2 = x2 + right_expand * w;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float ny1 = y1 - top_expand * h;
&nbsp; &nbsp; float ny2 = y2 + bottom_expand * h;

&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------
&nbsp; &nbsp; // 保持ROI尺寸，整体平移
&nbsp; &nbsp; //----------------------------

&nbsp; &nbsp; // X方向
&nbsp; &nbsp; if (nx1 &lt; 0)
&nbsp; &nbsp; {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; nx2 -= nx1;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; nx1 = 0;
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; if (nx2 &gt; in.img_w)
&nbsp; &nbsp; {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; float diff = nx2 - in.img_w;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; nx1 -= diff;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; nx2 = (float)in.img_w;

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (nx1 &lt; 0)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; nx1 = 0;
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; // Y方向
&nbsp; &nbsp; if (ny1 &lt; 0)
&nbsp; &nbsp; {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ny2 -= ny1;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ny1 = 0;
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; if (ny2 &gt; in.img_h)
&nbsp; &nbsp; {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; float diff = ny2 - in.img_h;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ny1 -= diff;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ny2 = (float)in.img_h;

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (ny1 &lt; 0)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ny1 = 0;
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; out.x1 = (int)std::round(nx1);
&nbsp; &nbsp; out.y1 = (int)std::round(ny1);
&nbsp; &nbsp; out.x2 = (int)std::round(nx2);
&nbsp; &nbsp; out.y2 = (int)std::round(ny2);

&nbsp; &nbsp; return out;
}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="5-人脸注册耗时较长优化">5. 人脸注册耗时较长优化</h1>
<p><strong>问题描述</strong></p>
<p>在服务器场景下，人脸相关应用初次工作起来时，会从数据库读取人脸特征信息注册到SDK内存，过程中可能会遇到注册耗时比较长的情况。</p>
<p><strong>推荐解决方案</strong></p>
<p>人脸SDK接口中有注册单一人脸和批量注册人脸接口。注册多个人脸时，可以使用批量注册人脸接口，减少SDK内部内存的搬运。另外，当程序刚起来时，从数据库读人脸特征信息注册到人脸SDK中时，可以一次性多注册一些人脸特征，例如一次性注册1000张人脸特征信息。这里的1000可以具体根据实际的设备内存情况调整。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public int registerFaceFeature(List&lt;FaceFeatureInfo&gt; faceFeatureInfoList)
</code></pre>
<p>另外，也可以调用人脸质量过滤接口，拦截一些低质量照片，降低服务器注册压力。</p>
<h2 id="6-人脸底库过大比对太慢怎么办">6. 人脸底库过大，比对太慢怎么办</h2>
<p><strong>问题描述</strong></p>
<p>服务器场景下，当人脸底库较大时，高并发的人脸特征请求会导致服务器压力过大，增加比对的耗时，如何提高识别的效率？</p>
<p><strong>推荐解决方案</strong></p>
<p>除了根据硬件情况，增加SDK引擎数量之外，还可以对人脸底库进行针对性的分组，将大人脸底库分成多个小底库，通过compareFaceFeature接口来实现并发比对。例如，在学校的业务场景中，全校可能有几千到上万人，可以根据班级以及行政机构将所有人按组划分，当产生课堂签到点名需求时，课堂上的终端设备上传抓拍照，并带上当前班级信息，后端服务器只需要比对当前班级所在组的人员信息就行。</p>
<h2 id="7-照片中多人脸如何选择合适的人脸进行比对">7. 照片中多人脸如何选择合适的人脸进行比对</h2>
<p><strong>问题描述</strong></p>
<p>目前的人脸SDK中支持设置最大检测人脸的数量，例如设置最大人脸检测数量为5个。当图片中出现多张人脸时，应该如何选择合适的人脸进行比对？</p>
<p><strong>推荐解决方案</strong></p>
<p>在门禁场景中，可以结合人脸质量分、最大人脸策略，选择最优的人脸进行人脸识别。</p>
<p>* &nbsp; &nbsp;检测到 N 张人脸<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ▼<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;┌──────────────────────────┐<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ Step 1: 质量分过滤 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ 对每张人脸做 imageQualityDetect │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ 保留 qualityScore &gt;= 60 的 │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;└──────────┬───────────────┘<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 有合格的?<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ┌─────┴─────┐<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;有 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;没有<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ▼ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ▼<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;┌─────────┐ &nbsp;┌──────────────┐<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ Step 2: │ &nbsp;│ Step 2: &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ 从合格 &nbsp;│ &nbsp;│ 退化为最大人脸 │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ 的中选 &nbsp;│ &nbsp;│ (直接选面积 &nbsp; │<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;│ 最大人脸│ &nbsp;│ &nbsp;最大的) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp;└────┬────┘ &nbsp;└──────┬───────┘<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; └───────┬──────┘<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ▼<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 返回选中的人脸</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">private FaceInfo findLargestFace(List&lt;FaceInfo&gt; faceInfoList) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (faceInfoList == null || faceInfoList.isEmpty()) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return null;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; FaceInfo largestFace = faceInfoList.get(0);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int largestArea = 0;

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for (FaceInfo faceInfo : faceInfoList) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Rect rect = faceInfo.getRect();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (rect != null) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; int area = rect.getWidth() * rect.getHeight();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (area &gt; largestArea) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; largestArea = area;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; largestFace = faceInfo;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Rect rect = largestFace.getRect();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; logger.info("最终选中: 面积 = {}", largestArea);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return largestFace;
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

public FaceInfo selectBestFace(ImageInfo imageInfo, List&lt;FaceInfo&gt; faceInfoList) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; // Step 1: 质量分过滤
&nbsp; &nbsp; List&lt;FaceInfo&gt; qualifiedFaces = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
&nbsp; &nbsp; for (int i = 0; i &lt; faceCount; i++) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ImageQuality imageQuality = new ImageQuality();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; faceEngineInstance.imageQualityDetect(imageInfo, faceInfo,
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; FaceQualityMask.ASF_FACE_QUALITY_WITH_LIVENESS.getValue(), imageQuality);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; float score = imageQuality.getQualityScore();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (score &gt;= QUALITY_THRESHOLD) { &nbsp;// 60.0f
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; qualifiedFaces.add(faceInfo); &nbsp;// 合格
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; // Step 2: 从合格的里面选面积最大的
&nbsp; &nbsp; if (!qualifiedFaces.isEmpty()) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return findLargestFace(qualifiedFaces); &nbsp;// 正常路径
&nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; // 全部不合格 → 降级为最大人脸
&nbsp; &nbsp; logger.warn("全部不合格，退化为最大人脸策略");
&nbsp; &nbsp; return findLargestFace(faceInfoList);
}

</code></pre>
<h2 id="8-调用人脸识别sdk-出现内存泄漏排查">8. 调用人脸识别SDK 出现内存泄漏排查</h2>
<p><strong>问题描述</strong></p>
<p>在调用人脸SDK Java版本接口开发相关应用时，会遇到内存泄露的情况，应该如何排查？</p>
<p><strong>推荐解决方案</strong></p>
<p>对于人脸SDK运行时内存可以分为java堆内存和native内存，java堆内存由JVM自己管理，会自动触发GC。而native内存是在人脸SDK中的so库中分配的，JVM无法管理。调用虹软人脸SDK时，最大的风险点就是创建了引擎，后续不使用时却没有及时给释放掉，导致native层内存泄漏。</p>
<p>例如，有的开发者可能会对于一个前端请求，就创建一个人脸SDK引擎，但是创建了之后却没有及时的释放，导致内存泄漏。建议创建引擎池来管理引擎，最后统一释放所有引擎，避免内存泄漏。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public void initPool() {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 初始化
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; logger.info("开始初始化人脸识别引擎实例池和线程池...");

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 初始化FaceEngine实例池
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; enginePool = new LinkedBlockingQueue&lt;&gt;(poolSize);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for (int i = 0; i &lt; poolSize; i++) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ArcFaceEngine arcFaceEngine = new ArcFaceEngine();
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 激活并初始化SDK引擎
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if (!arcFaceEngine.activateAndInitSdk(appId, sdkKey, activeKey, libPath)) {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; logger.error("人脸识别SDK初始化和激活失败，应用程序将无法正常运行。");
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 将初始化好的引擎放入队列
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; try{
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; enginePool.put(arcFaceEngine);&nbsp;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; logger.info("人脸识别引擎实例 {} 初始化成功并加入池中.", i);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }catch(InterruptedException e){
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; logger.error("人脸识别引擎实例 {} 加入池失败.", i);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return;
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; }

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; // 初始化线程池，大小与引擎池一致，以便每个线程可以独占一个引擎
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; executorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(poolSize);
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; logger.info("人脸识别线程池初始化成功，大小为: {}", poolSize);
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
</code></pre>


</div>
